notes.title: Replica Update Released.
notes.notes:
Hello, there.

Replica version 1.8 has been released.
The update will be applied automatically when you restart Replica. 
The major changes include:

[list]
[*]Improved Japanese localization with help of Playism
[*]Fixed compatibility with macOS 10.15 Catalina
[*]Fixed minor bugs
[/list]

And now you can find the new library hero image of Replica in the Steam client. :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25512235/612ea92aa9af5908deccef9deac57aad133474ce.png[/img]
